I was born and raised in New York City, the youngest of three children. My parents were both immigrants who came to America in search of a better life, and they instilled in me a strong work ethic and a love for learning. I attended a prestigious university on the East Coast, where I studied economics and political science. During my time there, I became deeply involved in student government and worked tirelessly to advocate for my fellow students.

After graduating, I moved to Washington D.C. to pursue a career in public service. I spent several years working in various government agencies, always striving to make a positive impact on the lives of those around me. I eventually landed a job at a prominent think tank, where I specialized in economic policy. It was a challenging but rewarding experience, as I was able to contribute to important research and publications that helped shape the national conversation around issues that mattered to me.

In my free time, I enjoyed exploring the city's many museums and cultural institutions. I also took up running and biking, and I quickly became a fixture in the local racing scene. I loved the sense of community that came with participating in these events, and I made many close friends along the way.

Despite my success in Washington D.C., I began to feel restless and yearned for new challenges. So, I decided to take a leap of faith and move across the country to San Francisco. I had always been fascinated by the tech industry, and I saw an opportunity to combine my passion for policy with my interest in technology.

Since moving to the Bay Area, I have worked at several startups in varying capacities, from operations to business development. I have thrived in this fast-paced, dynamic environment, and I have learned an incredible amount about myself and my abilities. I have also become involved in the local startup community, serving as a mentor to aspiring entrepreneurs and contributing to various initiatives aimed at promoting diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

Throughout my journey, I have remained committed to my values of hard work, integrity, and empathy. I believe that these qualities have been instrumental in my success, and I strive to live by them every day. Whether it's in my professional or personal life, I am always looking for ways to grow and improve, and I am excited to see what the future holds.
